Treatment Options:
• No OCT abnormality needing treatment
• Continue routine eye screening based on risk factors
Medicines (Doctor Review):
• No OCT-specific medicine
• Continue prescribed medicines for diabetes, BP, or cholesterol only if advised by doctor
Home Care & Other Options:
• Eat a healthy diet
• Stay physically active
• Control blood glucose and BP
• Avoid smoking
• Attend regular retinal screening

Treatment Options:
• See a retina specialist promptly
• Anti-VEGF eye injections are the main treatment for active CNV caused by wet AMD
• Some cases may need photodynamic therapy or other treatment depending on the cause
Medicines (Doctor Review):
• Ranibizumab
• Aflibercept
• Faricimab
• Bevacizumab may be used off-label
• Treatment and injection schedule depend on the cause and retinal findings
Home Care & Other Options:
• Do not delay specialist referral
• Monitor vision and distortion as advised
• Use an Amsler grid if advised
• Sudden vision changes need urgent eye assessment

Treatment Options:
• Check whether swelling affects the center of the macula
• Assess visual acuity
• Anti-VEGF injections are commonly used when center-involving DME affects vision
• Macular laser or steroid treatment may be considered in selected cases
Medicines (Doctor Review):
• Ranibizumab
• Aflibercept
• Faricimab
• Bevacizumab may be used off-label
• Dexamethasone implant or other eye steroids may be considered for selected patients
Home Care & Other Options:
• Maintain good diabetes control
• Maintain good BP control
• Attend retinal follow-ups
• Do not rely only on diet or home remedies instead of eye treatment

Treatment Options:
• Check whether drusen are linked with early, intermediate, or advanced AMD
• Small drusen may only need monitoring
• AREDS2 supplements may be considered for intermediate AMD or certain high-risk findings
• Advanced AMD with CNV needs specialist treatment
Medicines (Doctor Review):
• AREDS2 formulation may be recommended by an eye specialist for eligible patients
• Contains vitamin C, vitamin E, lutein, zeaxanthin, zinc, and copper
• It does not treat all drusen or remove existing drusen
Home Care & Other Options:
• Avoid smoking
• Eat a balanced diet with leafy greens
• Monitor central vision if advised
• Attend scheduled retinal examinations
• New distortion or central vision loss needs prompt assessment
